A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the alpha-fluorinated 4-pyrrolizin-5-ylpyridinium compounds are active in vivo, but the alpha-chlroropyridinium compounds are not.

The main takeaway from our work is that
alpha-haloalkylpyridinium salts are prodrugs of pyridones and that the rate of hydrolysis is a major factor in determining the antitumor activity of the pyridone.
